title: Tinio flags alleged 'pork' in House’s proposed 2027 national budget
summary: ACT Teachers Party List Representative Antonio Tinio flagged on Friday alleged “pork” in the proposed 2027 national budget, which the House of Representatives approved on 2nd reading last Wednesday.
